description.html: HabiStat Calci Shot is an extra source of calcium for reptiles, amphibians and other terrarium animals. It is pure calcium carbonate with no phosphorus, packed in a small 33 g plastic pot that is handy for a single refill or for keeping next to the terrarium.

The label gives simple instructions: open the pot and pour half of the powder into a calcium dish (Calci Dish), so the animal can take calcium as needed. The rest can be used to dust live food. Replace the calcium in the dish when it gets dirty or damp.

An animal can only use dietary calcium if it has proper UVB lighting, vitamin D3 in its diet, or both. Calci Shot contains no D3, so combine it with a UVB lamp or a D3 supplement. The label states that the product is not for human consumption.
